terms.title: Terms of Purchase & Use
terms.lead: How the HER POV digital guides are sold, licensed, delivered and supported.

sections.heading: The HER POV products
paragraphs: HER POV offers digital educational material for adults about starting conversations, responding with clarity, building authentic dating profiles, and navigating first-date planning. The product descriptions and prices on the checkout page determine what you buy.

The collection includes four standalone PDF guides and a Complete Library bundle. The bundle includes all four PDFs and the First Message Cheat Sheet bonus. The future AI Coach is not included in any current digital-guide purchase.

sections.heading: Who may purchase
paragraphs: You must be at least 18 years old and legally permitted to transact in your location. If you buy on behalf of someone else, you must have the right to use the payment method.

sections.heading: Prices, checkout & confirmation
paragraphs: Prices shown on the HER POV storefront are in US dollars (USD), generally as one-time purchases, unless a product listing expressly states otherwise. Your payment provider or issuing bank may apply currency conversion or fees. Any applicable taxes, when collected, should be disclosed before you confirm payment.

Payments are processed by Hotmart. A successful charge is not a subscription enrollment. Do not submit multiple payments if a transaction appears delayed: check the purchase confirmation or contact support.

sections.heading: Digital delivery and access
paragraphs: For a confirmed Hotmart purchase, access instructions for the purchased digital files are generally emailed to the address supplied at checkout. If the email does not arrive, check spam or junk and open your Hotmart purchases area to review access and seller support options.

Download files to your own device and store them safely. If a download is missing, corrupt or inaccessible, contact support with your order reference. We will make reasonable efforts to restore access or provide an appropriate remedy in accordance with applicable law.

sections.heading: Personal license & intellectual property
paragraphs: Purchase grants the buyer a limited, nonexclusive, nontransferable license to download and use the purchased materials for personal, noncommercial educational purposes. Copyright and ownership are not transferred.
points: Do not resell, republish, share publicly, sublicense or upload the full files to public repositories or file-sharing sites.
You may adapt an example message for your own conversations, but you may not distribute the underlying e-book or bonus as your own product.

sections.heading: Educational scope and respectful use
paragraphs: These are educational guides, not professional counseling, psychological treatment, legal advice or a method of controlling other people's decisions. You remain responsible for what you say and how you treat others.
No guide can guarantee replies, matches, dates, a relationship, or improved engagement. Respect privacy, consent, boundaries and a person's decision not to respond.

sections.heading: Refunds, disputes and statutory rights
paragraphs: Read the separate Refunds & Digital Delivery policy before purchase. Nothing in these terms limits non-waivable consumer protections, payment-dispute rights or mandatory remedies available in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Site availability, updates and contact
paragraphs: We may correct errors or update product descriptions and these terms prospectively. Material changes affecting an existing order will be handled according to applicable law. The terms applicable to your purchase are those presented at the time of purchase.

For order help, see our Contact & Order Support page. Buyers can also find the creator's contact information in their Hotmart purchase details. Review the seller identification shown on the checkout before placing an order.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.lead: How order details, delivery information and support communications may be used for HER POV digital purchases.

sections.heading: Scope and data controller
paragraphs: This notice concerns the HER POV storefront, checkout referrals, e-book delivery and support. The merchant identified below is responsible for the personal information it controls. Third-party providers may be independently responsible for certain processing under their own policies.

sections.heading: Information involved
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with the store, relevant information can include your email address, the name you choose to provide, product selection, order identifier, purchase amount, payment status, delivery history, customer support messages and technical data needed to operate the site and prevent abuse.
points: Hotmart processes payment information. The storefront is not designed to receive or store full card numbers.
Hotmart may process checkout, email and product-access details to fulfill digital purchases.
The storefront host may process technical request data and routine server logs. External font services may receive technical request information when their resources load.

sections.heading: Why we process information
paragraphs: We use necessary information to process and verify transactions, deliver purchased PDFs, respond to requests, protect the store against misuse or fraud, maintain records where legally necessary, and comply with legal requirements.

sections.heading: Legal grounds and communications
paragraphs: Where required by applicable law, we rely on grounds such as fulfilling the customer agreement, complying with legal obligations, legitimate operational and security interests, or valid consent. These grounds vary by jurisdiction.

Transactional receipts, downloads, access help and fraud notices are distinct from promotional marketing. Marketing communication would require a lawful basis and any consent required by your location.

sections.heading: Payments and service providers
paragraphs: Hotmart processes checkout payments and provides access to digital purchases made through its platform. This storefront is hosted by a separate website hosting provider. Each service provider handles information according to its role and applicable privacy notices.
We may also disclose information where legally required, to resolve a payment dispute or to protect customers and the platform from fraud.

sections.heading: International transfers, retention and security
paragraphs: Providers may process information in countries other than your home country. Required safeguards depend on the applicable jurisdiction and provider arrangements.

Records are retained only as appropriate for delivery, buyer support, accounting, fraud prevention and legal obligations; exact periods differ by data type and applicable law. No website or transmission system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your choices and privacy rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, objection or review of certain uses of your personal information. These rights are subject to applicable law and legal retention requirements.
To exercise a right, contact the operator using the details below. We may need reasonable verification that you are the relevant buyer, without asking for passwords or complete payment card details.

sections.heading: Cookies and website resources
paragraphs: The website uses optional Google Ads technology and Meta Pixel after you allow advertising in Privacy choices. Google and Meta may process page visits, advertising identifiers and device or browser information for advertising measurement. Meta receives page views and selected funnel actions, including checkout clicks with the offer value and currency. Optional advertising scripts are not loaded before your consent.

Privacy choices stores your analytics and advertising preferences in your browser for up to 180 days. You can reject optional tracking or reopen Privacy choices to change your selection. Our funnel events do not include your answers to the dating-conversation questionnaire, message text, email, or payment details. Opening the thank-you page is not recorded as a confirmed purchase.

The website may load external font resources. Hotmart operates its own checkout, payment and delivery interfaces, with its own privacy and cookie practices. Your choices on this website do not control tracking on Hotmart. Google Analytics has not been activated on this website at this stage.

sections.heading: Changes and questions
paragraphs: If our practices change, we will update this notice and handle material changes as required by law. For questions about personal data controlled by the HER POV seller, use the verified merchant contact below when published or the creator contact displayed in your Hotmart purchase details. For data processed by Hotmart, consult Hotmart's privacy and support channels.

refunds.title: Refunds & Digital Delivery
refunds.lead: What happens if a digital purchase is missing, defective, duplicated, or not what you expected.

sections.heading: Digital items and order contents
paragraphs: HER POV products are downloadable educational PDFs, not physical goods. The first standalone product includes its stated one-page bonus; other guides are separate unless you buy the Complete Library bundle.
Review the product name, included files, one-time price and applicable taxes before confirming payment. The bundle contains all four HER POV guides plus the bonus.

sections.heading: How delivery works
paragraphs: After Hotmart confirms your payment, it normally sends purchase confirmation and digital access instructions to the email used at checkout. Check your inbox and spam folder, then consult your Hotmart purchases area if the message is missing.

sections.heading: A missing, broken or incorrect download
paragraphs: If the paid file does not arrive, cannot be opened, or is not the product purchased, contact customer support with the receipt or order identifier. Do not send full card details. We will investigate and offer delivery correction, restored access, replacement or a refund when required by law or appropriate under the circumstances.

sections.heading: Refund requests
paragraphs: For a Hotmart order within its applicable guarantee period, you can request a refund through Hotmart's official refund portal using the transaction code from your receipt and the email associated with your purchase. You can also contact the creator using the details in your Hotmart order.

The guarantee period and conditions displayed for your purchase apply alongside any mandatory consumer rights. Downloading a PDF does not automatically remove statutory rights. This page does not create an additional unconditional refund guarantee.

sections.heading: Duplicate payments and unauthorized charges
paragraphs: If you were charged more than once for the same order or notice a payment you did not authorize, contact support promptly. You may also contact Hotmart or your card issuer through the normal dispute process. We will not ask for sensitive payment credentials to resolve an order.

sections.heading: Timing of any approved refund
paragraphs: If a refund is approved, it is submitted through the original payment provider where practicable. The time for funds to appear depends on the provider, bank, card network and relevant jurisdiction. We cannot guarantee a particular bank posting date.

contact.title: Contact & Order Support
contact.lead: Where to find help with purchases, downloads, billing and privacy requests.

sections.heading: Support for purchases
paragraphs: For an existing order, sign in to Hotmart using the email used at checkout and open the purchase details. You can find digital-access instructions and the creator's support contact there. If a verified HER POV email is published below, you may also contact us directly.
points: For a missing download, describe the product purchased and the message or error you saw.
For billing concerns, include the transaction date and order identifier.
For data/privacy requests, describe what information you are asking about. Do not include passwords or full card details.

sections.heading: Access, payments and refunds
paragraphs: Payments for HER POV products, when offered, are processed on Hotmart. This website does not collect credit-card details. Check the merchant, product, currency, total amount and guarantee terms shown on the checkout page before paying.

If you have bought a guide, use your Hotmart purchase confirmation to find the transaction number and access instructions. Eligible refunds may be requested directly through Hotmart's official refund portal.
